The Provost’s office’s position is that it is not appropriate for the FS to have appointees playing a role in decision-making about the individuals who will play a primary role in union negotiations.

The administration suggested a change to provide for more flexibility in moving to asynchronous course delivery in emergency situations, i.e. having that option after as little as two missed days rather than after three or more.
